/ The Chapter on whether any [Lig] /ht comes from the Three Vessels.
Mani taught that the universe was layered, with eight earths and ten heavens, and carefully constructed for the purification of the light. The term 'vessel (MANEJOPE )' is variously used in this complex cosmology. However, the reference to such surrounding the universe would seem to indicate the three vessels of water and darkness and fire that the Living Spirit first poured down from the heavens, and that he then swept out to ditches prepared for them at the edge of the universe. See chapters 42 - 45, especially 112.20 - 24. In any case, this kephalaion explains the mechanism by which light may be further refined, even from these vessels.
